title: SHEIN vs AliExpress: how to choose (shipping, delivery time, returns and import tax)

description: SHEIN and AliExpress side by side in the UK: shipping, delivery time, returns and import tax as each store publishes them, and what to check on each listing before paying.
metaDescription: 4CW5Y gives a discount on selected SHEIN offers. SHEIN or AliExpress in the UK: shipping, returns and tax side by side, and what to check.
imageAlt: Four pieces in store photos: a black ribbed dress and a striped shirt from AliExpress, a cream knit dress and a striped shirt from SHEIN, next to the question SHEIN or AliExpress?

takeIf: Choose AliExpress if the piece you want is sold there and its page shows free returns and a delivery forecast that works for you.
skipIf: Skip AliExpress if you want the same return rules on every order: SHEIN publishes one policy, while at AliExpress free returns depend on the listing.

editorialNote: This article is editorial. We may earn a commission on SHEIN and AliExpress links. No one on the team used the pieces shown.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: In the UK, SHEIN gives 14 days by law and, under its policy, most items up to 30 days after receipt. AliExpress gives 15 days after delivery with a local seller and 90 days from the order with an overseas one. Shipping and delivery time change by listing. On SHEIN, search 4CW5Y to get a discount.

[AliExpress](https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_c37RSyBR) is the Alibaba group's international marketplace: each piece is listed by a seller, with its own shipping, delivery time and return terms.

At AliExpress, the table gives the UK return policy and what the page of one piece showed on November 17, 2026: the shipping, forecast and free-return period belong to that listing, and another one can differ. contentSections.heading: Marketplace or store: what to check on the product page
paragraphs: At AliExpress the terms are the listing's, and the product page shows each one before payment. At SHEIN, shipping and returns follow the store's policy, and lingerie, underwear and costume jewelry only come back within the 14 days. Before buying, check:
bullets: **Who sells it:** at AliExpress, the seller's store name and its reviews; at SHEIN, the product page also shows who sells and the reviews.
**Shipping and the delivery forecast**, which at AliExpress change with the listing and with where the piece ships from.
**The guaranteed refund date** at AliExpress: if the parcel has not arrived by then, you can ask for the full amount back.
**Whether the piece has free returns** and for how many days. Without it, a return for a change of mind at AliExpress is paid by you.
**The total**, with shipping and any taxes, at the end of each store's checkout, and your name and address correct on the order.
postParagraphs: To see who runs SHEIN and what weighs on its reputation, read [Is SHEIN legit and safe?](/en/reviews/is-shein-legit-and-safe).

contentSections.heading: Import tax and customs
paragraphs: Import tax depends on the country. On its UK site, SHEIN says customers in the UK do not need to deal with customs. The AliExpress page of the piece we opened shows a notice that orders from outside the EU may pay VAT and customs charges. Before you pay, check at each store's checkout whether the total includes taxes, and compare that final figure, not just the price of the item.

contentSections.heading: Returns: SHEIN's rule and AliExpress's windows
bullets: **SHEIN:** 14 days by law from receipt and, under SHEIN's policy, most items up to 30 days after receipt; lingerie, underwear and costume jewelry only come back within the 14 days. The first return of each order is free; from the second, SHEIN deducts £2.50 from the refund.

**AliExpress, return window:** from purchase to 15 days after delivery with a local seller, and 90 days from the order with an overseas seller. For a change of mind, you pay the return, unless the product page advertises free returns (on the piece we opened, for 90 days).
**AliExpress, defective, damaged or not as described:** the seller pays the return. If the parcel does not arrive by the guaranteed refund date, you can ask for a full refund.
postParagraphs: At both stores, clothes only come back new, unworn, unwashed and with the tag; at AliExpress, also with the hygiene sticker. SHEIN's window applies to the items that accept returns; at AliExpress, free returns belong to the listing, so check the page before paying.

contentSections.heading: Which to choose: what to weigh
paragraphs: If you want more days to change your mind without depending on the listing, SHEIN gives up to 30 days after receipt on the items that accept returns. If the piece you want is on AliExpress, read the listing before paying: seller, delivery forecast, guaranteed refund date and free returns. Compare the total at each checkout, not the price of the piece.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Are SHEIN and AliExpress the same thing? No. SHEIN describes itself as a fashion retailer with its own brand, founded in 2012; AliExpress is the Alibaba group's international marketplace, where each seller has its own store.

Which arrives faster, SHEIN or AliExpress? It depends on the order and, at AliExpress, on the listing. SHEIN publishes 5 to 8 working days for Standard delivery in the UK, and AliExpress shows a forecast for each piece. Compare both before paying.

Which is cheaper, SHEIN or AliExpress? It depends on the piece and the seller. What changes the total is shipping, import tax and, at SHEIN, the discount from the referral code. Compare the total at the end of checkout.
Is AliExpress safe for buying clothes? AliExpress's policy provides a full refund if the parcel does not arrive by the guaranteed date, and accepts returns of clothes that are new, unworn and tagged.

Does 4CW5Y give a discount? Yes. It is Cecília's referral code at SHEIN and gives a discount on a selection of products and promotions; how much and on which items is SHEIN's call. Search for the code in the app or on the site, not in the coupon field.
